text: Bitcoin is holding steady near $65k while Ethereum treads water, suggesting neither major has conviction in either direction as fear sentiment dominates the market. Altcoins like BNB and SOL are outpacing the majors, a sign that risk appetite exists despite the Fear & Greed reading of 31—traders appear to be rotating into smaller-cap exposure rather than driving strength across the board. Bitcoin's 56.6% dominance remains elevated and volume is moderate at $32B, indicating cautious positioning without panic selling.
